result.summary: Found 1 critical visual issue: the bottom navigation is obscured by a thick black bar that blocks core navigation icons.

issues.description: A thick black horizontal bar overlaps the bottom navigation bar, completely obscuring the middle tab icons (search and saved/bookmark). Only the home and profile icons remain visible.
issues.suggestion: Add proper bottom safe-area padding so the tab bar sits above the OS gesture indicator, ensure the system indicator is rendered thin/translucent, and make all navigation icons fully visible and tappable.
